name: Intake Agent
description: Intercepts raw conversational marketing directives. Employs Gemini 1.5 Pro to parse semantic category bounds, flight timelines, and specific NBA 2K26 game modes, The City seasons, and VC bundles.
inputs: Raw text brief from 2K franchise brand manager, client context headers

name: Feasibility Agent
description: Calculates feasibility limits and contact boundaries across console, PC, and MyTEAM mobile companion app telemetry. Evaluates gamer contact frequency caps and suppresses over-messaged player segments.
outputs: Estimated target gamer cohort reach size

name: Prioritization Agent
description: Resolves priority overlaps when multiple live-service in-game events and ProPASS promotions clash. Evaluates campaign tiers, seasonal multipliers, and 2K VIP loyalty status.
inputs: Estimated cohort stats, prioritization rules weights
outputs: Ranked campaign schedule, adjusted priority scores

name: Research Agent
description: Performs real-time search grounding to validate proposed campaigns. Benchmarks pricing and concepts against major digital storefronts (PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, Steam, 2K Store) and sports gaming trends.
inputs: Theme objectives, target items, competitor exclusion briefs
outputs: Market validation logs, trend alignment scores
dataNeeded: Gamer search and community trend indices

name: Creative Gen Agent
description: Assembles dynamic display banners and marketing copy templates. Triggers Imagen 3 Image Generation for photorealistic court action and superstar player visuals and saves them to GCS.
inputs: Approved concept specs, tone options (e.g. Competitive, Hype, Streetball)
outputs: WebP Banners (GCS URL references) + Display copies

name: Validation Agent
description: Reviews all generated copies and display layouts. Compares text strings and image attributes against ESRB/PEGI in-game purchases guidelines, FTC sponsorship rules, and competitor exclusions.
inputs: Draft banner images, copy variations, brand guidelines
outputs: Compliance checklist report, trademark match triggers

name: Integration Agent
description: Validates double supervisor electronic signatures, seals finalized payloads, and delivers verified packages directly to live-service push and 2K CRM channel routers.
inputs: Completed campaign assets + verified franchise producer signoff keys
outputs: Signed outbound REST payload transfer packet

name: Model Agent
description: Monitors campaign conversion and in-game engagement analytics. Identifies conversion prediction drops to automatically recommend and cue new custom models on top of BigQuery telemetry.
inputs: Historical conversion logs, data requests frequency, prediction errors
outputs: Machine learning model recommendations, training queue triggers

name: Judge Agent
description: Examines final campaign strategy, creatives, feasibility, and compliance to identify gaps, pros/cons, and analytics insights for NBA 2K26.
inputs: Cumulative preceding agent inputs, logs, and artifacts
